Bench: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, Ashutosh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 1205 of 2022
Petitioner :- Tarik Khan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Gaurav Singh Chauhan

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Surya Prakash Kesarwani,J.
Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for State-respondents.

This writ petition has been filed praying for the following relief:
"i. issue a writ of certiorari to quash order dated 7.8.2019 (Case No. 994 of 2017 (D201711170994) (State versus Tarik Khan) passed by respondent no. 2 under Section 51 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and quash the Recovery Certificate No. 20213619142000051 sum of Rs.40,000/- dated 14.7.2021 passed by Additional District Collector/Judicial Officer, Bulandshahar (respondent no. 2) under Section 51 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006."

Against the impugned order, the petitioner has a right of appeal under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, therefore, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case of the Tarik Khan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 May, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71540502/

Office is directed to return certified copy of the impugned order to the petitioner after retaining a photostat copy thereof in the records.
